title: Config report response
description: 200 response to POST /api/v1/reports/config. A retried report (same report_id) is answered with duplicate: true and changes nothing.

duplicate.description: True when this report_id was already processed.

manifest_version.description: The server's current manifest version. When it is higher than the report's, the agent should fetch GET /api/v1/manifest/config again before its next report.
